# #140 - AI-jättarnas nya moat - eller bara ett spel för galleriet?

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts describe a nervous September market. OMXS30 fell 2.24% on the week, the US 10-year yield is above 5%, oil is above $100, a Fed hike is almost fully priced in, and the US midterm elections are coming. They argue that fear, with the Fear & Greed Index at 28, can set up a healthier long-term rally. The main segment asks whether calls by Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI to slow AI development are a sincere safety concern or an attempt to build a regulatory moat. They also discuss types of moat (brand, network effects, switching costs, patents, technology, proprietary data, regulation) and note that cybersecurity stocks are seen as winners.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The Hugging Face acquisition is called a very important deal. Picks-and-shovels role in the AI arms race, plus hardware, CUDA and a technology moat.

#### Reasoning

The host says buying Hugging Face gives Nvidia a real-time view of what is trending in open-source AI, adding to its hardware and CUDA lead. The hosts argue the geopolitical AI arms race makes a real slowdown unlikely, which supports demand. No explicit buy call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US regulation actually slows AI development
- if the AI capex boom slows down

> *"Det här är liksom, tror jag, ett jätteviktigt förvärv för Nvidia."*

---

### 🟠 CRWD — CrowdStrike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cybersecurity stocks seen as winners after the AI-agent hacking incident. Demand for security grows with AI-written code.

#### Reasoning

The hosts argue the more code AI writes, the more cybersecurity is needed, and that this need grows exponentially. CrowdStrike and Palo Alto have risen sharply. The host warns the stock is a separate matter from the demand story, so valuation is a caveat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation already prices in the demand growth
- if cybersecurity demand slows

> *"det lär ju inte minska avtag i styrka, i alla fall inte behovet. Aktien är ju en annan femma."*

---

### 🟠 PANW — Palo Alto Networks | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Named with CrowdStrike as a cybersecurity winner from AI-driven security demand.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as CrowdStrike: an exploding volume of AI output drives demand for security. The strong gains so far and the host's valuation caveat limit conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation already prices in the demand growth
- if cybersecurity demand slows

> *"Crowdstrike, Palo Alto med flera har varit i rampljuset."*
